Name: Review bi-directional relationships
Description: Bi-directional relationships can create unexpected filter propagation paths. Verify against the project filter equivalence matrix.

Name: Ensure fact table surrogate/high cardinality keys are hidden
Description: High cardinality keys in fact tables should be hidden from report consumer view.
Expression: Table.Name == "目前職缺" and Name.EndsWith("編號") and not IsHidden

Name: Provide format strings for visible measures
Description: All visible numeric measures should have an explicit format string configured.

Name: Active relationships must connect valid columns
Description: Ensure active relationships connect existing from and to columns.
Expression: IsActive and (FromColumn == null or ToColumn == null)

Name: Model tables must use Import mode
Description: All active model tables in JobWant semantic model must use Import mode.
